{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Floor-length gown, A-line with a softly flowing skirt, sleeveless with a modest V-neckline, dusty sage green (#9CAF88), chiffon with a lined bodice

Wrap-style shoulder shawl, hip length, ivory (#F3EBDD), light silk-blend voile, carried for the evening and for sun protection during the outdoor ceremony

Heeled sandals, block heel (about 6 cm), open toe with an ankle strap, nude beige (#D8B99B), smooth leather, steady enough for walking on grass

Clutch, small envelope shape, champagne gold (#D9C39A), satin with a metallic finish

Drop earrings, small and delicate, gold tone (#C9A24D), polished metal

Thin bracelet, slim bangle, gold tone (#C9A24D), polished metal

Why this outfit works: The formal floor-length gown in a soft sage tone feels celebratory and elegant without competing with the bride, and it suits a family member attending her sister's wedding. Chiffon keeps it light and breathable for an August afternoon outdoors, while the sleeveless cut with an airy skirt handles the warmth. Block heels hold up on grass at the 16:00 ceremony and stay comfortable through the restaurant dinner. The sheer shawl is an accessory rather than a warm layer, giving shoulder coverage in the sun and a polished finish indoors, and the gold details tie everything together with a single quiet point of shine."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2422,"output_tokens":494},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
